page.layout: One printed page (right of the scan). Running head at top with page number 65. Main text in one column with brace-set outlines in the middle and a catchword-like "Amplif-" at the foot. Narrow text at the left edge belongs to the facing page and is in the left margin: several fragments of notes on the left side. Right margin empty.

main_text.p: mum excellentiæ membrum, quo fit vt sit maximè cœleste & diuinum, à sola summaq; sapientia profectum. Gen. 18.19. 1.Reg.2.1.2.3.4.Exod.13.5.Psa.19. 8.17. 1.Tim.6.4.Psa.11.1.2.& 119.132.Act.18.26.Heb. 1. 1.Reg.2.15. 2.Pet.5.2,
Quod sit perfectum, est secundum membrum excellentiæ,quo omni modo ad proprium finem sic consummatum.

Æternitas,est primum membrum perfectionis,qua totum inuiolatum semper consistit, donec finis & fructus æternus obtineatur.Math.5.18. 1.Cor. 15.28. Heb.8.6.7.8.9.10.1.Ioh.1. Col.3.17. Heb.7.12.& 8.5. Gal.3.22.23.24. Mat.24.35. & 26.52. 1.Cor.9.8.13.14. Apoc.13.10.
Absoluta efformatio est secundum membrum perfectionis,qua naturam habet omnino absolutè constitutam.
main_text.l: Eius duo { Quod sit purgatiss. } Proue.30.
main_text.p: Purgatissimum,est primum membrum absolutæ efformationis,unde tum materia,tum dictionis forma sit prorsus a vera,b pura,c sana,d clara, e genuina. (a) Prou.8.6.7.8. 2.Timo.2.18. 2.Ioha. 1. 2. 1. Tim.1.2. & 6.3.4.5. 2.Thess.2.10.12. (b) Ioha.3.15. Psalm.19. 2.Thef.2.10.12. (c) 1.Timo. 6.3.4. & 4.6 2.Tim. 1.13. Psalm.119.43. 1.Tim. 6.20. (d) Psalm. 19.8.9. & .119. 131. (e) Psalm. 119. 7. 8.9. 10. &c.

page.notes: Left margin contains fragmentary notes from the facing page (e.g. "maxi-", "dendæ", "Ro.9.9.", "ch.20.14", "Psalm.", "ou.8.6.", "oc.4.18") which are cut off and only partly legible; not transcribed in full. The braces in the outline are rendered as paired lines; the bracket contents are otherwise as printed. Marks a–e are superscript reference letters in the text. Last line "E" with "Amplif-" is a catchword-style signature at the foot of the page.
